name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: An animated breadcrumb for React and shadcn, folding middle crumbs into a menu when space runs out.

meta.details: A trail from the root to the current page that folds its middle crumbs into a menu when it runs out of room, measured rather than guessed, with links that underline on hover.

docs: Import Breadcrumb from components/eased/breadcrumb/breadcrumb. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
